a: अया — ind. Ved. Thus, in this manner.

a: अयाशु — a. Ved. 1 Unfit for copulation. --2 Destructive of good things.

a: अयाथार्थिक — a. (की f.) 1 Not true, wrong, unjust, improper. --2 Not real or genuine, incongruous, absurd.

m: अ-याथार्थ्य n. the being अ-यथार्थ (q.v.) incongruousness, L.
a: अयाथार्थ्यं — 1 Unfitness, incorrectness. --2 Absurdity, incongruity.

अयाचिताहृत mfn. offered without having been solicited, Yājñ. i, 215.

Unasked, unsolicited (as alms, food &c.); अमृतं स्यादयाचितं Ms. 4. 5; 11. 212. --तः N. of the sage Upavarṣa. --तं Unsolicited alms. --Comp. --उपनत, --उपस्थित a. got unasked or without solicitation; अयाचितोपस्थितमंबु केवलं Ku. 5. 22. --वृत्तिः, --व्रतं subsisting on alms got without begging or solicitation.

अयाचितोपनीत mfn. id. Comm. on Mn. iv, 247.

m: अ-याज्य mfn. (√ यज्), a person for whom one must not offer sacrifices, outcast, degraded, ŚBr. xiv; KātyŚr.; Mn. &c., not to be offered in a sacrifice.
a: अयाज्य — a. 1 (A person) for whom one must not perform sacrifices, not competent to offer sacrifices (as a Śūdra &c.). --2 (Hence), Out-cast; degraded, not admissible to or incapable of religious ceremonies. --3 Not fit for sacrificial offerings. --Comp. --याजनं, --संयाज्यं sacrificing for a person for whom one must not perform sacrifices; Ms. 3. 65; 11. 60.

not a night-watch, any time during daylight.

अयान्वित m. N. of Śaṃkarācārya, L.

अयास् (आस्), n. (ind.) fire, Uṇ.
a: अयास् — a. [fr. इ ‘to go’ Nir.] Ved. Agile, nimble. --याः ind. [इ-आसिः Uṇ. 4. 221] Fire.

a: अयासोमीयं — N. of some verses of the Sāma Veda.

m: अयास्य mfn. (4) (= ἀϊζήϊος Windisch; cf. अयास् and अइआस् before), agile, dexterous, valiant, RV.
अयास्य m. N. of an Aṅgiras (composer of the hymns, RV. ix, 44-66 and x, 67 and 68), RV. x, 67, 1 and 108, 8; ŚBr. xiv.
a: अयास्य — a. Ved. Indefatigable, inexhaustible, valiant, invincible. --स्यः 1 A mystical name for the chief life-wind. --2 N. of Aṅgirasa.

m: अ-यात mfn. not gone, AV. x, 8, 8.
a: अयात — a. Not &c. gone. --Comp. --पूर्व a. following, succeeding, subsequent to. --याम a. not old or weakened, not stale, fresh, not worn out by use; ˚मं च यौवनं Dk. 123 fresh, blooming; ˚मं वयः 158; छंदांस्ययातयामानि Bhāg. (where Śrīdhara says अ˚ = विगतदोषाणि free from faults, faultless, pure. --(मं) N. of certain texts of the Yajurveda revealed to Yājñavalkya. ˚यामता freshness, unimpaired nature, strength, or vigour, purity.) --यामन् a. Ved. not weak, fresh.

अ-यातयाम—ता (अयातयाम-) f. unweakened strength, freshness, ŚBr. & AitBr.
अ-यातयाम—त्व (अयतयाम-) n. id., TS. ii.
अ-यात्रा f. the state of not being passable (as the sea), R. iv, 27, 16.
अयात्रिक or अयात्रीय, mfn. inauspicious (?), Hāla, Sch.

Not to be warred against, unassailable; irresistible; अद्यायोध्या महाबाहो अयोध्या प्रतिभाति नः Rām. --ध्या The capital of solar kings, born of the line of Raghu, (the modern Oudh) situated on the river Sarayū. [It is said to have extended 48 miles in length and 12 miles in breadth. It was also called Sāketa, and one of its suburbs was Nandi-grāma, where Bharata governed the kingdom during the absence of Rāma. The town plays an important part in the story of the Rāmāyaṇa; the second book ( अयोध्याकांड) dealing mostly with events that took place in that city during the youthful days of Rāma.]

a: अयोनि — a. 1 Without origin or source, eternal; जगद्योनिरयोनिस्त्वं Ku. 2. 9. --2 Not born from the womb; born in a manner not approved by law or religion. --निः f. 1 Not the womb; Y. 2. 293; Ms. 11. 174. --2 Not a particular verse of the Sāmaveda. --निः 1 N. of Brahmā and Śiva. --2 A pestle. --Comp. --ज, --जन्मन् a. not born from the womb, not produced in the ordinary course of generation; शरीरं द्विविधं योनिजमयोनिजं चेति T. S; तनयां अयोनिजां R. 11. 47, 48; कन्यारत्नमयोनिजन्म भवतामास्ते Mv. 1. 30. --(जः) N. of Viṣṇu. ˚ईशः, ईश्वरः N. of Śiva. (--जा), --संभवा N. of Sītā, daughter of Janaka, who was born from a furrow in a field.

SarIratyavahAraH u॰ vf॰ ॥ vfkzAdInAmayonijaSarIrasattve pramARAntaramasti “SarIrajEH karmmadozEryAti sTAvaratAM naraH” manunA karmaviSezErnarARAM tadBAvaprAptiruktA । “guruM tuNkftya huNkftya vipraM “aniyatadigdeSAH parAmaRaboDarmmaviSezajanitakarmmARastatpUrvvakatvAt ayonijaSarIrARAm nanu paramARUnAM karmma vinA kaTaM dravyAsamavAyikAraRaM saMyogamantareRa dravyotpattirata Aha । kzudrajantUnAmUzmajAnAM yAtanAmayAni SarIrARyutpadyante ityapi drazwavyam devarzIRAmayonije SarIre pramARAntaramAha । samAKyA anvarTA saMjYA SrutismftItihAsapurARAdizu saMjYAyAAditvAt prasidDA taTAhi durvvAsaHpraBftayo mAnasAH “ahaNkAreByaH samaBabadaNgirA” ityAdikA, taTA'pi jYAyate santyayonijAni SarIrARi devarzIRAmiti pramARAntaramAha । sargAdO yA brahmAdisaMjYA AdiBftA prATamikI tayA jYAyate astyayonijaM SarIramiti nahi tadA brahmaRo mAtApitarO staH yAByAM brahmAdisaMjYA kftA syAditi BAvaH uprasaMharati । “santyayonijAH” “vedaliNgAcca vE॰ sU॰” SarIraviSezA iti SezaH a: अयुक्त — a. 1 Not yoked or harnessed. --2 Not joined, united or connected. --3 Not devout or pious, inattentive, negligent. --4 Unpractised, unused, unemployed; ˚बुद्धि, ˚चार. --5 Unfit, improper, unsuitable; अयुक्तोयं निर्देशः P. अ-युक्त—ता, f. or अ-युक्त—त्व, n. the not being used, the not being suitable.
